proposition: POST /api/v1/payment: contract says an authorized user can receive a successful session response; implementation does pass null as the request used to derive the session return URL.

target.field: request used for session return URL
target.direction: successful session response versus null request dereference

mandatory_search.reason: §11.4.1 deterministic null crash candidate; verify guards, helper and exception mapping.

manual_additions.reason: Generic Exception handler maps null dereference to INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR; excludes only argument mismatch and unreadable JSON.

decision.rationale: The endpoint passes null through the processor to getReturnUrl, which dereferences request before the StripeException catch. Authorized session creation therefore contains a deterministic implementation crash; no contract change is needed.
decision.details: §11.4.1 deterministic non-gateway exception rule. Null is supplied by server endpoint, not an omitted public field. Appropriate authenticated user/cart preconditions isolate the path. No external Stripe request is reached after this null dereference; no runtime/network execution performed. PaymentExceptionHandler catches StripeSessionCreationException, not null failure.
